USAGE:
    ironhive [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
    -v, --version                Prints version information                     
    -p, --prompt <PROMPT>        Run a single prompt and exit                   
    -m, --model <MODEL>          Model to use (e.g., gpt-4o-mini, llama3.2)     
        --provider <PROVIDER>    Provider (openai, ollama, gpustack)            
        --show-tokens            Show token usage statistics                    
        --show-thinking          Show thinking/reasoning content from the model 
        --no-stream              Disable streaming output (wait for complete    
                                 response)                                      
        --plan                   Enter planning mode (read-only exploration)    
        --dry-run                Show what would be done without executing      
        --update                 Check for updates after execution              
    -c, --continue               Continue the most recent session               
    -r, --resume <SESSION_ID>    Resume a specific session by ID                
        --fork                   Fork the resumed session (create a new branch  
                                 from the session)                              
    -o, --output <FORMAT>        Output format: text (default), json, jsonl     
                                 (streaming JSON lines)                         
        --plain                  Plain text output without ANSI colors,         
                                 spinners, or formatting                        

COMMANDS:
    run                  Run a single prompt and exit                   
    set <KEY> <VALUE>    Set a configuration value                      
    get                  Get a configuration value                      
    unset <KEY>          Remove a configuration value                   
    config               Show all configuration                         
    models               List available models from configured providers
    doctor               Diagnose configuration and connectivity issues 
    update               Check for and install updates                  
    sessions             List and manage conversation sessions
